method.open: SQLite URI mode=ro; PRAGMA query_only=ON; one BEGIN/COMMIT read transaction
method.authorization: SQLite authorizer permits only SELECT, read transaction, and the exact listed table/column pairs; other columns and tables denied

queries.sessions: SELECT id, agent_id, cwd, native_session_id, created_at FROM sessions ORDER BY id
queries.agents: SELECT id, source, command, created_at FROM agents ORDER BY id
queries.dismissed_sessions: SELECT id, created_at FROM dismissed_sessions ORDER BY id

method.canonicalJson: UTF-8 json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')); SHA-256 lowercase hex
method.perRecordHash: Hash object composed only of identityFields; ID is stored separately and is not repeated inside the per-record hash
method.aggregateHash: Hash ID-sorted array of {id, identitySha256}; ID-list hash uses ID-sorted string array
method.postInstallCheck: For each pre-install record ID, require it still exists and its identitySha256 matches; report new IDs separately. Compare dismissed records the same way; do not silently accept missing originals. Compare aggregate hashes only when record sets are equal.

limits: This evidence records index identity preservation, not conversation-body completeness or native-history recovery.
Agent identity covers id/source/command/created_at only; arguments, environment, credentials, handshake and configuration were not queried or hashed.
updated_at is deliberately excluded because opening an existing conversation can legitimately refresh it.
Legacy p0 full-table hashes have different field coverage and are retained only as provenance, not compared to these identity hashes.
This is one read-transaction snapshot. Later authorized first-message/performance samples may add records and are outside this timestamp.
Added counts are cumulative since the original pre-install baseline; the difference from candidate 3 is a net count change, not attribution to a particular test.
Only original protected record identities are emitted. Newly added IDs, private titles, record bodies, settings, credentials and native histories are not included.
This check did not write the database, use the UI, start an Agent, alter source code or run engineering tests.
